Cares about his students. |id2 = PROFESSOR_1, MASTER_PROFESSOR_1 }} '''The Professor''' is the {{MobCategory|Boss}} of [[Catacombs - Floor III]] of [[The Catacombs]]. == Collection == Killing the Professor increases '''The Professor''' collection. {{CollectionTable|The Professor}} {{/Collection UI}} == Boss Fight == === Phases === '''The Professor''' fight has three distinct phases: {|class="wikitable" ! Phase ! Description |- | First | In the first phase, the Professor is surrounded by a barrier at the beginning of the fight, preventing players from dealing damage through it. To end the first phase, all of The Professor's Guardians must be defeated. Each guardian has a special attack/ability. The Guardians are revived with {{Green|80%}} (Normal) / {{Green|90%}} ([[Master Mode]]) {{Stat|health}} after 10 seconds (7 in [[Master Mode]]) of being killed. |- | Second | In the second phase, all four guardians are dead, and the player must fight the Professor until they reach {{Red|25%}} of their {{Stat|Health}}, or {{HP|750,000}} and {{HP|150,000,000}} in [[Master Mode]]. |- | Third | In his third phase, the Professor absorbs the dead guardians and transforms into a Guardian himself. He will spawn {{MobSprite|Rogue Guardian}}s, and occasionally use the {{AN|Giga Heal}}, {{AN|TNT Rain}}, and {{AN|Focus Laser}} abilities. If the fight goes on for too long, the arena will flood but spawn in several boats. Once the Professor is defeated, Necron will smite him with lightning and warn the players not to go further before he deals with them himself. |} === Attacks === Below are a list of attacks of each mob. More details about the guardian's attacks can be seen on their respective pages. ==== The Professor ==== {|class="wikitable" ! Attack ! Allowed Phases ! Description |- | Melee | Second | The Professor has a melee attack, dealing damage to players he strikes. |- | {{AN|Prismarine Blizzard}} | Second | The Professor summons prismarine blocks in a path towards the player, dealing {{Red|5%}} ({{Red|15%}} in [[Master Mode]]) of the player's max {{Stat|Health}} as {{Stat|True Damage}}. |- | Laser | Third | The Professor will fire a laser at the player, attacking every {{Green|0.75 seconds}} using its base {{Stat|Damage}}. |- | {{AN|TNT Rain}} | Third | The Professor flings TNT around him in all directions, which detonate and deal its base {{Stat|Damage}}. |- | {{AN|Giga Heal}} | Third | The Professor begins a countdown. At the end of this countdown, he and all the {{MobSprite|Rogue Guardian}}s in the room are healed fully. |} ==== {{MobSprite|Chaos Guardian}} ==== {|class="wikitable" ! Ability ! Description |- | {{AN|Discharge}} | The Chaos Guardian has an {{Red|Anger Level}} above its head, which is indicated by the amount of {{Yellow|⚡ lightning icons}} it has. Hitting the guardian enough times will increase the level, up to level 6. Every two seconds, the Chaos Guardian will strike lightning around itself, damaging players who are nearby. This deals {{Red|0.5x}} the base {{Stat|Damage}} in normal mode, or {{Red|0.7x}} it in [[Master Mode]], multiplied by the {{Red|Anger Level}}. Upon reaching {{Red|Anger Level}} 6, the level will reset down to 1, and the guardian will prepare to '''overcharge'''. Several seconds later, lightning will rapidly strike in the surrounding area for several seconds, dealing the amount of {{Stat|Damage}} equivalent to an {{Red|Anger Level}} or 12, or {{Stat|Damage|17,280|icononly=yes}} in normal mode and {{Stat|Damage|453,600}} in [[Master Mode]]. |- | {{AN|Body Slam}} | Hits itself into the ground when a player gets too close, dealing immense [[Knockback]], {{Red|2x}} the base {{Stat|Damage}} in normal mode ({{Stat|Damage|5,760|icononly=yes}}), or {{Red|6x}} it in [[Master Mode]] ({{Stat|Damage|324,000|icononly=yes}}). |} ==== {{MobSprite|Healthy Guardian}} ==== {|class="wikitable" ! Ability ! Description |- | {{AN|Giga Heal}} | The Healthy Guardian will announce that a {{AN|Giga Heal}} is about to occur, which will heal all of the alive guardians in 10 seconds (8 in [[Master Mode]]). During this time, attacking the Healthy Guardian will reduce the healed amount by {{Red|5%}} per hit. Hitting 20 times will stop all healing from occurring. The base amount healed is {{Stat|Health|10,000,000}}, or {{Stat|Health|210,000,000}} in [[Master Mode]]. Upon healing, the next announcement will occur 60 seconds later (45s in [[Master Mode]]). |- | {{AN|Body Slam}} | Hits itself into the ground when a player gets too close, dealing immense [[Knockback]], {{Red|2x}} the base {{Stat|Damage}} in normal mode ({{Stat|Damage|8,784|icononly=yes}}), or {{Red|6x}} it in [[Master Mode]] ({{Stat|Damage|486,000|icononly=yes}}). |} ==== {{MobSprite|Reinforced Guardian}} ==== {|class="wikitable" ! Ability ! Description |- | Higher {{Stat|Health}} | The Reinforced Guardian has higher {{Stat|Health}} compared to the other guardians. |- | {{MobSprite|Rogue Guardian}}s | The Reinforced Guardian will repeatedly spawn {{MobSprite|Rogue Guardian}}s around itself in the air. These will fly around, firing lasers at any nearby players. After being alive for some time, they will turn into Elder Rogue Guardians, which have higher [[Stats]]. |- | {{AN|TNT Rain}} | Every ~40 seconds (or ~30s in [[Master Mode]]), the Reinforced Guardian will start throwing TNT around itself for 10 seconds. This TNT deals {{Red|0.6x}} the base {{Stat|Damage}} in normal mode ({{Stat|Damage|3,024|icononly=yes}}), or {{Red|0.8x}} it in [[Master Mode]] ({{Stat|Damage|64,800|icononly=yes}}). This timer runs independently of the Reinforged Guardian's alive state, meaning killing it does not impact this timer. If the TNT rain were to start when the boss is otherwise dead, it gets skipped. |- | {{AN|Body Slam}} | Hits itself into the ground when a player gets too close, dealing immense [[Knockback]], {{Red|2x}} the base {{Stat|Damage}} in normal mode ({{Stat|Damage|10,080|icononly=yes}}), or {{Red|6x}} it in [[Master Mode]] ({{Stat|Damage|486,000|icononly=yes}}). |} ==== {{MobSprite|Laser Guardian}} ==== {|class="wikitable" ! Ability ! Description |- | Default Laser | By default, the Laser Guardian will fire a standard, slower laser at the player, attacking every {{Green|0.75 seconds}} using its base {{Stat|Damage}}. |- | {{AN|Focus Beam}} | Starting 10s into the fight, the Laser Guardian will begin the following looping process: * Announce that the {{AN|Focus Beam}} is being charged up. This disables the default laser, and takes {{Green|15s}} in normal mode or 10 seconds in [[Master Mode]]. * Start firing the higher powered {{AN|Focus Beam}} instead of the default laser. This attacks at a faster {{Green|0.5s}} rate and has a higher reach, but only deals {{Red|0.1x}} the base {{Stat|Damage}} in normal mode ({{Stat|Damage|432|icononly=yes}}), or {{Red|0.6x}} it in [[Master Mode]] ({{Stat|Damage|48,600|icononly=yes}}). This laser lasts for {{Green|60s}} in normal mode and {{Green|45s}} in [[Master Mode]]. * Announce that the {{AN|Focus Beam}} has overheated and is on cooldown, which lasts for {{Green|10s}}. * Repeat this process. If the Laser Guardian dies, once it respawns, the same cooldown message is sent {{Green|5s}} after, meaning the laser starts building up {{Green|15s}} later. |- | {{AN|Body Slam}} | Hits itself into the ground when a player gets too close, dealing immense [[Knockback]], {{Red|2x}} the base {{Stat|Damage}} in normal mode ({{Stat|Damage|8,640|icononly=yes}}), or {{Red|6x}} it in [[Master Mode]] ({{Stat|Damage|486,000|icononly=yes}}). |} === Guardians === {{Mob Table| {{Mob Table Row|Chaos Guardian}} {{Mob Table Row|Healthy Guardian}} {{Mob Table Row|Reinforced Guardian}} {{Mob Table Row|Laser Guardian}} {{Mob Table Row|Rogue Guardian}} }} === Master Mode Changes === * The Professor has {{Hp|600M}} and his guardians {{Hp|120M}} and {{Hp|140M}}. All attacks deal more {{Stat|Damage}}. * {{MobSprite|Rogue Guardian}}s immediately spawn as the Elder variant. * Guardians are revived after 7 seconds instead of 10. * When Guardians are revived, they regain {{Green|90%}} of their {{Stat|health}} instead of {{Green|80%}}. * The {{MobSprite|Healthy Guardian}} is invulnerable when performing {{AN|Giga Heal}}, however, {{AN|Giga Heal}} can still be interrupted by hitting the Guardian enough times. == Drops == Killing the Professor directly grants the following drops: {{Mob Drops Table |level = 362-940 |coins = 905-2,350 |combat_xp = 2,715-7,050 |orbs = 1,086-2,820 }} Defeating him in the third phase will also complete the fight, unlocking [[Dungeon Reward Chest]]s with their own loot: {{:The Catacombs - Floor III/Loot}} [[Master Mode]] Loot: {{:The Catacombs - Floor III/Master Mode Loot}} == Variants == {{Mob Variants |level = 362 |spawn_location = [[The Catacombs - Floor III]] |health = 3,000,000 |damage = 5,976 |coins = 905 |combat_xp = 2,715 |orbs = 1,086 |id = PROFESSOR_1 |level2 = 940 |spawn_location2 = [[The Catacombs - Floor III|The Master Mode Catacombs - Floor III]] |health2 = 600,000,000 |damage2 = 135,000 |coins2 = 2,350 |combat_xp2 = 7,050 |orbs2 = 2,820 |id2 = MASTER_PROFESSOR_1 }} == Strategies == {{Main|Tutorials/Dungeon Ultimate Guide#The Professor}} == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable" !Condition !Dialogue |- | class="ct" | Intro |{{Dialogue| &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: I was burdened with terrible news recently... &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: My most talented student... &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: I'll show you real power! Nobody has managed to take three of my Guardians down before! &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: My Guardians! }} |- | class="ct" | While using Revive | {{Dialogue| &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: Revive, (name)! &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: My technique is much more advanced than Scarf's.. &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: My barrier will hold as long as my Guardians are alive. &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: Give up Adventurers, it only takes me a few seconds to revive my guardians. &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: I can do this all day. &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: Perfect offense and defense, I am INVINCIBLE! }} |- | class="ct" | While using Volley | {{Dialogue| &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: No more hiding! &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: Dodge this! &c[BOSS] The Professor&f: Here! Show them your power!}} |- |} == Trivia == * The Floor III boss was called Oak in the Alpha Hypixel Network.https://ibb.co/NCQp6f3https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3C3seezNuYg&t=12 ** This was a reference to Professor Oak from the ''Pokémon'' franchise. ** It is unknown why it was changed. * This is the first usage of Elder Guardians in Hypixel SkyBlock. * This is the first time [[Necron]] interacts with the player. *[[Necron]] killed The Professor after he was defeated. * The Professor canonically taught Scarf the Necromancy skills they have; however, he also has other unknown students. * The Rogue Guardians can be absorbed by Necromancer Sword and Reaper Scythe, making them the only non-undead mob to be able to be summoned. * His head has the same texture as [[Sadan]]'s, except that it has been recolored and the brows are missing. *Although the professor is the one who drops [[Adaptive Armor]], the armor is upgraded with [[Scarf Fragment]]s. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2026/June 24|Nerfed the regular base {{Stat|Damage}} from {{Stat|Damage|6,640|icononly=yes}} to {{Stat|Damage|5,976|icononly=yes}} and the [[Master Mode]] base {{Stat|Damage}} from {{Stat|Damage|150,000|icononly=yes}} to {{Stat|Damage|135,000|icononly=yes}}.}} {{History|2026/Aug 25|Changed the [[Mob Level]]s from {{Level|1}} to {{Level|362-940}}, {{Coins}} from {{Gold|1}} to {{Gold|905-2,350}}, {{Experience}} from {{Dark Aqua|200}} to {{Dark Aqua|1,086-2,820}}, and {{Skill|Combat}} XP from {{Dark Aqua|400-600}} to {{Dark Aqua|2,715-7,050}}.}} |beta= {{History|0.8|[[File:The Professor.png|26px]] Added '''The Professor'''.}} {{History|0.26.1|Nerfed the regular base {{Stat|Damage}} from {{Stat|Damage|6,640|icononly=yes}} to {{Stat|Damage|5,976|icononly=yes}} and the [[Master Mode]] base {{Stat|Damage}} from {{Stat|Damage|150,000|icononly=yes}} to {{Stat|Damage|135,000|icononly=yes}}.}} {{History|0.27.2|Changed the [[Mob Level]]s from {{Level|1}} to {{Level|362-940}}, {{Coins}} from {{Gold|1}} to {{Gold|905-2,350}}, {{Experience}} from {{Dark Aqua|200}} to {{Dark Aqua|1,086-2,820}}, and {{Skill|Combat}} XP from {{Dark Aqua|400-600}} to {{Dark Aqua|2,715-7,050}}.}} }} == References == {{Reflist}} == Navigation == {{Nav/Catacombs}} [[Category:Catacombs]] [[Category:Dungeons]] [[Category:Bosses]] [[Category:Boss Collections]]
